citation: Bassami M, MacLaren DPM, Ahmadizad S, et al. Effects of Mixed Isoenergetic Meals on Fat and Carbohydrate Metabolism during Exercise in Older Men. Journal of Nutrition and Metabolism. 2011.
protocol: 30 min cycling at 60% VO2max after four different meals (normal, high fat, high-carbohydrate high-GI, high-carbohydrate low-GI) on four visits
population: n=8 healthy older men, age 63.3+/-5.2 y, body fat 21%, VO2max 36.9+/-10.4 mL/kg/min
note: Older-adult flag. No data tables in the paper; numbers are in text and figures, so treated as figure-dominant. 'Values in the text are mean (+/-SE)'.
